purpose: Show that projection-loss magnitude and independently transferable added-axis organization are separate inferential layers with distinct empirical terminal states.

A.title: Projection hides added ecological state
content: thickness magnitude = H(added axes | retained base axes)
organization = dependence of added state on declared base/identity state

B.title: Vertical thickness without transferable x-y organization
B.visual_encoding: Show descriptive thickness separately from the two negative sealed gains; do not use one combined mean as the terminal decision.

C.title: Temporal thickness with transferable species-time organization
C.visual_encoding: Show the partition test and all three positive fold gains; label the result as camera-detected local-clock-time organization, not causal temporal displacement.

D.title: Distinct empirical states of multidimensional inference
D.take_home: Do not collapse unavailable, thick/non-generalizing and thick/generalizing into a single multidimensional-niche verdict.

caption_claim_ceiling.allowed: The empirical lanes demonstrate that added-axis thickness magnitude and transferable conditioned organization are separable inferential properties.
forbidden: Temporal niche dimensions are generally more stable than vertical dimensions.
The bat and Serengeti information values are directly comparable biological effect sizes.
Positive temporal partition proves competition or temporal displacement.
Any panel supplies an empirical N3 state map.
